name: Meli
storyline:
Surrounded by voices that refuse to fade and memories that slowly twist into nightmares, you awaken in a place that should not exist. Abandoned school hallways, endless fog, and a city that pulses to the rhythm of a constant bass drag you forward… even when you don’t know why.

Discover new ways to move and flow through the environment, confront whatever tries to stop you, and push ahead through lights, chaos, and music. Every step carries emotion. Every sound feels like a warning.

This is only a first glimpse into the world of Meli.
What comes next… is something you must experience for yourself.
summary: Dive into the void with Meli
